end.summary:
Named family members and described ways they care for one another.
Gave examples of helping, including bringing water, fetching slippers, and telling a story.
Recognised that families can differ in size while living together.
Clarified that “above” referred to the family chart, not family importance.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Trisha practised naming family members and describing care, such as making tea, bringing medicine, helping in the kitchen, and sitting with Dadi. They also explained that families may have different numbers of people but can still live together. There was a brief mix-up about Dadi being “above” others in the chart, and Trisha corrected this by referring to the chart line later in the lesson. At home, ask Trisha to name two family members and one way each person helps or cares for someone.
